blind.description: A solid, cubic architectural block of hand-painted dressed stone masonry. Each vertical side features a blind rounded arch framed by curved stone voussoirs. The top surface consists of a symmetrical arrangement of stone paving slabs with rounded bevels. Surfaces are completely solid and continuous with stylized worn edges; no floating pieces, holes, or melting. Stands directly on its flat bottom without an additional plinth. Materials are weathered brown, ochre, and grey stone with faint green moss in the recessed mortar joints.
blind.from_above: A square top surface divided into a symmetrical 3x3 stone tile pattern: a central rounded square paver surrounded by four rectangular edge slabs and four corner pavers, separated by mossy recessed seams.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.5 to 5 feet tall (roughly 80% the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 4.5 to 5 feet wide and deep.
